Turn on the Bluetooth function of the mobile phone, click the setting of the smart king client---my device---add the device, then the mobile phone will automatically search for the wristband device. When the device is in the normal power-on state, the device name will appear. Click the device name to connect. can.

When the device is still unable to find the device near the phone, please check if the device is turned on or the battery is exhausted. If you search for the device and the device name appears, but you can\'t connect it, try turning the phone\'s Bluetooth function off and then on again, or Restart your phone. If your phone is connected to another bracelet before, be sure to delete or disconnect and then search for a new bracelet.
3. Description of the step data and sleep monitoring data

When you find that the step data is not synchronized with the bracelet, or the smart king software step data is not updated, please try to manually synchronize the data, sometimes the bracelet storage data is too large, it takes a certain time for Bluetooth to automatically update the data. In addition, we use the motion sensor to collect the step data in real time, compare the personal setting information such as the height and height of men and women, and convert and analyze the closest to the real step counter environment, so as to distinguish between different actions such as running, jogging and walking. . When the bracelet starts Bluetooth connection, the bracelet does not count the number of movement steps at the beginning of the action. Only when you actually walk for dozens of times, the device starts to recognize the motion state and starts counting the steps, so you will find When the bracelet is worn for the first time, the wristband does not count. In addition, sleep monitoring is also through a motion sensor in the wristband device to capture data analysis, so to test the sleep data, you must first wear a bracelet and then go to sleep, sleep data is designed for the night sleep state, so Only sleep conditions at night can be monitored and sleep data cannot be tested during the day.
4. Install Smart King APP/APK requirements for mobile phone system
The mobile phone must be Android 4.3 and ios8.2 or higher to install the software and connect the bracelet device.
